title: Product Stride — Daily Scrapbook
content:
2026-03-12 — morning brain dump

07:45 — quick pass through inbox. Important: legal asked for data retention note in PRD (see Confluence link). Add short paragraph + pointer to privacy team.

08:10 — standup takeaways (notes to self):
- Eng: kernel selection experiment finishing EOD (Marco). Need perf numbers before noon to decide canary target.
- SRE: green on dedicated pool autoscale test, but spike handling needs retry backoff tweak.
- DX: SDK change land Friday; update examples in PRD to match param names.

TODAY top priorities (must ship by EOD for demo):
1) PRD edits: final section "rollout plan" + migration notes for existing customers (inline bullet list). TODO: write migration checklist, assign to Lina for copy.
2) Canary run plan: decide traffic % and fallback policy. Need perf numbers + cost estimate.
3) Stakeholder followups: legal, infra, and solutions (see messages below).
4) Demo prep: one-pager + short script.

Quick PRD edits (copy fragments I will paste into PRD later):
- "Rollout approach: staged canary across regions. Stage 1: internal smoke (0.5% traffic) for 24h, validate latency and errors. Stage 2: 5% for 48h with automatic rollback on error-rate > 1.5x baseline or 95th pct latency > 150ms. Stage 3: 25% with monitoring retention increased to 14 days for traces."
- "Migration notes: existing Dedicated customers must opt-in to new kv-cache format. Customers on <v2.3 must run migrator tool (link to ops runbook). Provide 2-week notice and support window."

Stakeholder quick messages (to send after lunch):
- Legal (Renee): "Adding short data retention + audit log paragraph to PRD. Can you confirm wording for 'customer-managed keys' and 'retention exceptions by request'?"
- Infra (Devon): "Need exact VM sizing for canary (estimated 2x baseline). Can you validate cost estimate in sheet by 11:30?"
- Solutions (Aisha): "Demo script draft attached. Need a 10-min customer-friendly walkthrough of rollback behavior."

Launch checklist (working) — mark statuses as [ ] open / [x] done / [~] partial
[ ] final PRD text reviewed by legal (+ privacy) — action: Renee
[~] instrumentation hooks validated (traces + token breakdown) — need retention increase — action: SRE
[ ] canary traffic config ready in routing service — action: platform team
[ ] demo script rehearsed with PM/SE — action: Sophie/Aisha (16:00)
[ ] customer-notification draft — action: comms
[~] SDK examples updated — DX landed but docs not yet published

Risks / open questions:
- If kernel perf numbers are lower than expected we need fallback to quantized model variant; ensure model mapping policy exists (who owns this mapping? ask Marco).
- Migration complexity for Dedicated customers — does Professional Services need to be looped earlier? (Lina to review contract language)
- Cost estimate for canary is rough — double-check egress and burst capacity charges.

Notes from PRD review yesterday (comments to address):
- PM review: add explicit SLO targets (p50, p95) per region (TODO: copy numbers from benchmark doc).
- Eng review: clarify KV cache invalidation semantics during rollout (we need a clear TTL suggestion).
- DX review: examples must include new param names for streaming resignation API.

Mini action plan (by time):
- 09:30–11:30: lock down PRD rollout + migration paragraphs, push to Confluence.
- 11:30–12:00: sync with Marco on perf numbers + decide canary %.
- 13:00–14:00: stakeholder chase (Legal/Infra/Solutions).
- 14:00–15:30: demo deck + script.
- 15:30–16:00: runthrough with Aisha.
- 16:30: final publish + notify comms.

Personal reminders / notes to self:
- Keep messages short and include explicit asks (deadline + expected reply format).
- When making rollback thresholds, prefer conservative defaults and make them tunable.
- Save a short 'what could go wrong' paragraph for the executive one-pager.

Afternoon quick log (placeholder, fill at EOD)
- 17:45 — PRD updated? (y/n)
- 17:50 — Canary percent chosen?
- 18:00 — Demo rehearsal result + next steps

Scratch ideas for follow-up doc (separate):
- "Canary playbook for model variants" — step-by-step runbook + automated rollback scripts.
- Short evaluation harness for drift + quality regression monitoring (tie to Optimize).

Random friction notes (to file a ticket):
- Route config UI hides 'fallback policy' behind an advanced menu — many SREs missed it during test. Could we surface it for canary flows?
- Docs: example missing header about 'cost impact of batching' — add short table.

End of day checklist (copy into release notes):
- PRD link + changelog (one bullet summary)
- Canary schedule (start time + expected duration)
- Point people + slack channel

---
Raw message drafts (put directly into Slack thread when ready):
@Renee: "Quick question — added small data retention blurb to PRD. Does this wording cover KMS/HSM exceptions? If not, propose edits here: <link>"
@Devon: "Can you confirm VM sizing for canary by 11:30? I put a conservative estimate in the sheet; want to avoid underprovisioning."
@Aisha: "Can we block 16:00 for a 20-min runthrough of the demo? Need to validate customer narrative and rollback example."

End scrapbook.

(unfinished — will update after runthrough)
